description: Fetch a single channel's state (config, members) and its most recent messages. Note: uses Stream's get-or-create endpoint — for an existing channel it reads; if the type/id does not exist it may be created empty. POST /api/v2/chat/channels/{type}/{id}/query.

id.description: Channel id (the part after the type).

name: stream_get_channel
title: Get channel state + recent messages
